$comment: Contract of the CardStack blocks (escala-governance step 2): CardStack and its part CardStackCard on the Figma page ❖ CardStack (PRO). An arrangement of escala-ui components in role tokens. Accepted exceptions: the travel photos are stand-ins (stock content, not tokens); the Skip stamp (critical solid) is not in the file, which draws only the Shortlist stamp.

blocks.name: CardStack
anatomy: Column on Spacing/gap-section: stage 320 × 518.5 over the actions row
stage: the top CardStackCard + two deck layers (Surface/layer-2, Border/default, Radius/container, Shadow/sm) offset 8 and 16
Empty: dashed panel (Border/default, Radius/container) with 'That’s every card', '<n> decided · <m> shortlisted' and Button secondary outline 'Start over'
actions: Button secondary outline 'Skip' (close) · IconButton ghost undo · Button default solid 'Shortlist' (heart); Skip and Shortlist disabled when Empty
behaviour: The stage is focusable (aria-roledescription="card stack"); ← skips, → shortlists, Backspace or Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes
Drag the top card: past 96 px it decides, under it springs back
Only the top three cards are drawn
a11y: A polite live region announces each decision and undo
The top card is labelled with its name and position

motion.mechanism: the card follows the pointer, never timed
the card travels off and fades
layers and the returning card travel in

blocks.name: CardStackCard
anatomy: Card 320: Surface/layer-2, Border/default, Radius/container, padding Spacing/inset-surface, gap Spacing/gap-group, Shadow/sm (Dragging: Shadow/md)
facts: three rows, icon Size/icon-sm Content/subtle + Type/body-sm
Dragging: stamp Badge success solid, rotated -8°
a11y: The card is labelled with its name and position

motion.mechanism: the card rotates and moves with the pointer
